# S&S Landscaping

> Premier landscaping & outdoor living in Silicon Valley & the Bay Area

## About
S&S Landscaping provides premium landscaping and outdoor living services across Silicon Valley and the San Francisco Bay Area, including landscaping and planting, hardscaping, site preparation, irrigation and drainage, and outdoor amenities. Licensed and insured (LIC 100-7487). Contact Samuel Delgado (209-979-6677) or Santos Gomez (408-391-1591) at services@snslandscaping.org.
